In November 2025, GP Industries announced that it intends to shift production capacity to its manufacturing sites in Southeast Asia to serve the US market amid tariffs and rising geopolitical tensions. The company currently operates three facilities in Malaysia, two in Vietnam, and one in Thailand, alongside two other plants in the UK and one plant in China, which will now focus primarily on the European and Asian markets. The capacity adjustments are intended to streamline supply chains to meet country-of-origin requirements while maintaining cost competitiveness. Meanwhile, Gold Peak Technology (parent of GP Industries) is planning an investment program in Johor, Malaysia, to produce next-generation batteries to support data centres. GP Industries is the second-largest producer of consumer batteries globally, producing over 6 billion batteries annually, which are sold through 1 million outlets worldwide.
